payload.reason: The evidence provides specific evaluation criteria and metrics used to assess the generated text, including edit distance, word error rate, and manual evaluations.

claims.text: The evaluation includes measuring the edit distance of the generated text compared to its corrected variant, reflecting the effort needed for corrections.
The word error rate (WER) of the generated text is reported as 5.6%, indicating the accuracy of the generated output.
Manual evaluations are conducted to assess the acceptability of the output for production use in a news agency.
The model is evaluated using gold standard event selection, comparing generated event descriptions to reference texts.
